insights.headline: MCX gold slid below Rs 1.48 lakh as oil-driven Fed hike bets hammered bullion; ETFs fell up to 4%
insights.summary: Gold fell to a seven-week low near $4,200 on Monday as Brent crude near $108 revived expectations of another US Fed rate hike in October, lifting Treasury yields and the dollar. On MCX, October gold futures closed down 2.42% at Rs 1,47,225 per 10 grams and December silver fell 3.22% to Rs 2,27,133 per kg, while Indian gold and silver ETFs dropped up to 4%. The rupee weakened toward 96 per dollar, and analysts cited Rs 1,47,300-1,48,000 as immediate MCX gold support ahead of US inflation and jobs data this week.
points: Spot gold touched its lowest since early August; silver fell over 4% as 10-year US yields topped 5.2%.
MCX gold broke below Rs 1.5 lakh; silver crashed below Rs 2.28 lakh per kg on global cues.
Indian gold and silver ETFs fell up to 4%, tracking the physical-market selloff.
Rupee slid toward 96/USD on surging crude; Nomura sees up to 50 bps of RBI hikes by December.
Kotak cut its gold import outlook as high prices, duties and a shift to ETFs weigh on demand.

trending.title: Rate-hike repricing rules bullion
trending.summary: Surging oil revived October Fed-hike bets, lifting yields and the dollar and sinking gold to a seven-week low; Indian analysts see US inflation and payrolls data this week deciding the next move.

trending.title: Domestic amplifiers: rupee and RBI
trending.summary: The rupee closed at 96.03 per dollar on surging crude, and Nomura expects the RBI to raise rates by up to 50 bps by December — both keeping domestic gold prices elevated.

trending.title: Silver's two stories: crash today, $80 tomorrow
trending.summary: Silver plunged over 4% with gold, yet UBS forecasts $80 an ounce by September 2027 on gold and industrial demand — and analysts say the metal could shine again on any dovish turn.

trending.title: Import demand weakens as prices bite
trending.summary: Kotak Institutional Equities flagged softer gold imports as high prices, elevated duties and a shift to ETFs and digital gold weigh on physical demand.

trending.title: Paper gold feels the same pain
trending.summary: Gold and silver ETFs tumbled up to 4% alongside physical prices, showing the selloff spared neither bars nor funds.

items.title: Gold, silver plunge up to 3% as oil surge, rate-hike bets trigger sell-off. What lies ahead?
items.summary: MCX October gold futures fell 2.42% to Rs 1,47,225 per 10 grams and December silver futures dropped 3.22% to Rs 2,27,133 per kg as surging crude and rising US yields revived bets on another Fed rate hike in October. Analysts cited by ET put immediate MCX gold support at Rs 1,47,300-1,48,000, with US inflation and jobs data due this week seen as the next trigger.

Spot gold slid to a seven-week low below $4,200 on Monday as surging oil prices on the US-Iran standoff stoked inflation fears and bets on further Fed rate hikes, lifting Treasury yields and the dollar. Markets see a 70.3% chance of a Fed hike in October. Silver fell alongside ahead of US PCE and jobs data.
items.title: Gold hits 7-week low as oil-driven inflation fears boost rate-hike bets

items.summary: Indian gold and silver ETFs tumbled up to 4% on Monday, mirroring the sharp fall in bullion as Fed rate-hike bets strengthened. The slide tracked MCX futures lower, with higher US yields and a firm dollar cited as the immediate triggers.
items.title: Why Gold, silver ETFs tumbled over 4% today | What's behind the fall and what should investors do?
Surge in crude oil prices continue to pressurize INR
items.summary: The rupee fell 28 paise to close at 96.03 per dollar on Monday as the US rejection of Iran's proposal dimmed hopes of the Strait of Hormuz reopening, keeping Brent crude near $108. Elevated oil and firm US yields are likely to keep pressuring the rupee, which keeps domestic gold prices elevated even when global prices fall.

Kotak Institutional Equities breaks down the decline in India's gold imports — softer demand at high prices, elevated import duties and a shift toward ETFs and digital gold — and what it means for domestic premiums, MCX prices and festive-season buying.
items.title: Explained - The good, bad and ugly about the decline in Gold imports by Kotak Institutional Equities

items.summary: UBS expects silver to recover to $70 an ounce by December 2026 and reach $80 by September 2027, via $75 in March and June 2027, citing support from higher gold prices and tighter near-term physical fundamentals — while cautioning that a more hawkish Fed remains a near-term headwind.
items.title: Silver Could Reach $80 by September 2027, According to UBS Forecast

items.summary: Nomura expects the RBI to raise rates by a cumulative 25-50 basis points by December — assigning an 80% probability — ahead of the October 5-7 policy meeting, while dismissing market fears of 125 bps of hikes over the next year. It sees a terminal repo rate of 5.75%, arguing a full tightening cycle is unlikely.
items.title: Will RBI announce steep rate hikes? Nomura sees up to 50 bps increase by Dec, dismisses 125 bps hike fears
